archetypes.name: session-binding
archetypes.rationale: Stop hook session-id fallback is subtle and fail-open sensitive.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Stop hook session_id handling before tmpdir resolution. Check that empty, missing, null, and jq-missing payloads clear stale inherited state while non-empty session ids still bind the resolver. Verify the hook remains fail-open and the documentation matches the script behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
